content:
Programming Language Reference: C
Version: ISO/IEC 9899:2018 (C17 / C23)
Syntax: Imperative, procedural systems programming language providing direct mapping to hardware instructions.
Semantics: Compiled to native machine code, manual memory management, undefined behavior (UB) for out-of-bounds or invalid pointer operations.
Type System: Statically and weakly typed, basic arithmetic types, pointers, structs, unions, and enums.
Memory Model: Manual heap allocation via malloc/free, automatic stack frames, static/global data segments, direct raw memory addressing.
Concurrency: POSIX threads (pthreads), C11 threads.h, atomic operations (stdatomic.h).
Error Handling: Return codes, errno global thread-local variable, setjmp/longjmp for non-local jumps.
Standard APIs: stdio.h, stdlib.h, string.h, math.h, stdint.h, pthread.h
Specification: ISO/IEC 9899 Standard
Official Docs: https://en.cppreference.com/w/c
